raw.text: As an archivist, I am trained to evaluate situations through the lens of long-term preservation and systemic resilience. While immediate flood relief addresses an acute and urgent crisis, pandemic-preparedness research aligns with the core archival philosophy of safeguarding the future against large-scale, compounding disruptions. Methodically weighing immediate triage against proactive foresight, I will direct the funds toward long-term preparedness to ensure systemic stability for the future.
